decision_rule: Per instance, rank the 5 methods by best-of-16 at 1e-4. Pre-registered hypothesis: on concave instances, harden-nocompress is within 1e-3 of harden on >=5/7 instances (the disk-compress phase is unnecessary, per C03's ltri result). Also report, per instance, the minimal morph in {quarter, half, full} reaching within 1e-3 of the instance best (descriptive companion to the meta-analysis).
hypothesis: The C03 localization generalizes: on concave instances the compress phase contributes nothing (nocompress ~= harden) and a quarter-morph suffices; rigid trails on the instances where C01 found harden wins.
question: Which part of the methodology matters, for which concave shapes?
title: Morph-part factorial on concave instances
